<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/checkout_sessions/{id}"}
#docs
`status` is open, completing or completed, or revoked / expired when either applies. `resulting_subscription` is set once it completes. `customer_prefill` / `billing_address_prefill` appear when the session was minted with prefill. The token is never returned: it is not stored.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | cosess_… checkout session public id |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `checkout_session`. One of `checkout_session`. |
| `id` | `string` | The checkout session id. |
| `mode` | `string` | What the session does. One of `create`, `change`, `purchase`. |
| `status` | `string` | The session state. One of `open`, `completing`, `completed`, `revoked`, `expired`. |
| `subscription` | `string` | The subscription that the session changes. |
| `resulting_subscription` | `string` | The subscription that the session created or changed. |
| `resulting_invoice` | `string` | The invoice that a `purchase` session raised. |
| `customer` | `string` | The customer that the session created or used. |
| `items` | `array of object` | The items in the session. |
| `coupons` | `array of string` | The coupon codes applied. |
| `replace_items_list` | `boolean` | True if the items list replaces the subscription's items. |
| `replace_coupon_list` | `boolean` | True if the coupons replace the subscription's coupons. |
| `reset_term` | `boolean` | True if the change starts a new term. |
| `reactivate` | `boolean` | True if the session reactivates a cancelled subscription. |
| `reactivate_from` | `string · ISO-8601` | When reactivation starts. |
| `redirect_url` | `string` | Where checkout sends the buyer after payment. |
| `cancel_url` | `string` | Where checkout sends the buyer who leaves. |
| `pass_thru_content` | `string` | Text that comes back to you unchanged when the session finishes. |
| `metadata` | `object` | Your key-value data. |
| `customer_prefill` | `object` | The customer fields that the session pre-fills. |
| `billing_address_prefill` | `object` | The billing address fields that the session pre-fills. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the session was created. |
| `expires_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the session stops working. |
| `completed_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the buyer finished checkout. |
| `revoked_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the session was revoked. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Checkout session |
| `404` | No such checkout session |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/checkout_sessions/cosess_XXXXXXXXXXXX01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
